summary: Conditionally forwards an audio-effect request (a1, a2) to sub_5506A0(a1, a2, 0) based on two effect-flag dwords on the base object dword_7C54E0. If the flag at offset 3984 (0xF90) is non-zero the call result becomes the return candidate; if the flag at offset 3964 (0xF7C) is non-zero the function returns the call result immediately. When neither flag is set it returns the base object pointer dword_7C54E0. Called from steering-wheel, wheel-rotation, and random-collision feedback paths.

operations.description: Seed result with the base object pointer dword_7C54E0.
When the dword at offset 3984 (0xF90) of the base object is non-zero, call sub_5506A0(a1, a2, 0) and store its result.
When the dword at offset 3964 (0xF7C) of the base object is non-zero, return the result of sub_5506A0(a1, a2, 0) immediately.
Return the last computed result: the base pointer dword_7C54E0 when no flag was set, otherwise the audio-trigger call result.

unresolved: The object behind dword_7C54E0 and the semantics of its flag dwords at offsets 3964 and 3984 are unconfirmed.
The sound/effect behavior of sub_5506A0(a1, a2, 0) and the meanings of a1 and a2 are unknown.
The odd fallback of returning the base pointer dword_7C54E0 when neither flag is set is unexplained.
